name: Threaded Highline Leash Kit 3.50 m, no rings
description:
The Threaded Highline Leash Kit is the complete solution to tying into your highline! It comes with your choice of length threaded leash constructed from a 9.8mm Dynamic Rope threaded through 11/16" Slack-Spec Tubular, your choice of leash rings, and a protection sleeve for where the leash is connected to the leash rings.
Built from high quality materials, this leash is made to withstand many leash falls. We have put this leash through exhaustive testing involving several hundred leash falls onto the same leash with zero signs of wear. If you are looking for a burly leash that you can trust your life to, this is one to get.
The leash itself is the perfect length to allow you to have a strong knot with a backup knot on both ends and still have enough room for an adequately long leash. The girth of the leash as well as the soft hand makes for an easy climb after a leash fall.
notes: ISA:37 certified (approved_gear_32, 'Threaded Highline Leash', Leash Teather). Live Shopify, 2026-10-16. Colours Black, Blue, Green, Red, Silver. Sold without rings or with 2 BC Loop rings (BC Aluminum Leash Ring, 60 mm ID, 24 kN; Purple / Maroon / one of each), taped together; one row per length and ring option (operator, 2026-10-17). Protection sleeve included. The rope is not named; BC sells Sterling 9.8mm Dynamic Rope 'for the ultimate highline leash'. No leash strength stated (11/16" Slack-Spec: 13.3 kN). Geko (MX) resells it as 'Leash': 12.5 mm, 3.7 m, 368 g, MXN 799. History: 2012 US$49.95, SKU T-LEASH, 12 ft, 9.9 mm dynamic (7 class-2 falls), pre-tied fig-8 to 2x 2-5/16" forged steel rings (22.2 kN each), 1,240 g, made in USA; 2014 from US$35.95; 2022 US$39 / 55 (2 black rings) / 69 (BigLoop). SKU pattern S-LEASH-350-<colour>-NR.

name: Alpine Leash Kit 3.35 m
description:
The Alpine Leash Kit is a super lightweight leash for those long approach lines or Freestyle lines where every gram matters! It comes with your choice of length threaded leash constructed from a 7.7mm Twin Dynamic Rope threaded through 15mm Tubular Nylon, your choice of leash rings, and a protection sleeve for where the leash is connected to the leash rings.
With a weight range of 234 - 262 grams, depending on the length you choose, this leash is 27% lighter than our standard Threaded Highline Leash. That makes a big difference for those long hikes in or those big rotational tricks on the freestyle line.
Built from high quality materials, this leash is made to withstand many leash falls. We have put this leash through exhaustive testing involving several hundred leash falls onto the same leash with zero signs of wear. If you are looking for a burly leash that you can trust your life to, this is one to get.
notes: Live Shopify, product created 2026-02-11. Colours Purple, Yellow. Rings: none, or 2x BC Loop (60 mm ID, 24 kN), taped. Protection sleeve included. No strength stated, no ISA certificate. The page's length guide says 3.60 m for the 3.55 m variant. With two rings US$61, 341 g.

name: Highline Leash, no ring
description:
SLACKTIVITY’s Highline Leash was tested according to the safety standard ISA 37, by the International Slackline Association, wich makes it the best choice for securing yourself to a highline.
Now, SLACKTIVITY’s highline leash features sewn ends, ensuring that the sleeve and rope are fixed together, making sure they cannot slide apart.
A dynamic Edelrid climbing rope (Hummingbird Pro Dry 9.2mm) is threaded through a 20mm Nylon tubular webbing to create a redundant leash with a tight fit. The webbing has a soft feel to it, which makes it easy to climb after a leashfall and to untie your knot afterwards. The black edges are great for detecting twists in your Highline Leash, so that a whipper does not send you spinning around.
The length of 320cm is perfect to tie a figure-8 knot on your harness and to the leash ring, and still have sufficient length to walk without getting bothered by the leash.
notes: ISA:37 certified (approved_gear_4, 'HighlineLeash', Leash Teather, Siebert Consulting 2020-01). Sold with no ring (EUR 49), one ring (EUR 65) or two rings (EUR 79) — the shop's variant prices on 2026-10-17 — one row each, grouped (operator, 2026-10-17). Colours LSD, Green, White. 17 kN = 'Breaking load Edelrid Hummingbird Pro Dry 9.2 with Figure-8'. The page gives 350 g for the leash with one ring; the ring alone is 51 g. Sewn ends since about 2023. The feature list names Hummingbird ECO Dry (EN 892, 6 % static / 31 % dynamic elongation). Made in Switzerland. Manuals: https://slacktivity.com/wp-content/uploads/2021/02/Manual_EN_HighlineLeash_V1.pdf (EN), .../Bedienungsanleitung_DE_HighlineLeash_V1.pdf (DE). History: 2019 slacktivity.ch 'HighlineLeash' from CHF 65, 410 g, with 2x HighlineRing 7075-T6 (48 g, 20 kN, not PPE) and WhiteTube 320 cm; rope named as Edelrid Topaz Pro Dry 9.2 and, elsewhere on the page, Sterling Nano Fusion 9.0. 2019 slacktivity.com 'Leash (short)' EUR 49.95, SKU LEASH-1, 310-330 cm, '9,7mm Dynamic rope (18% @ 10kN)', for a middle leash. 2021: ISA certified, one tested 6061-T6 ring (39 kN), CHF 65, 350 g.

name: PRO Highline Leash
description:
The raed PRO Highline Leash is a durable, comfortable, grippy and soft leash for your highline rigs.
The leash has a thickness of 12.7mm and a braided cover. This unique combination makes it easier for you to grip and climb the leash. The cover also comes with easily detectable stripe design that's even visible at bad light conditions due to its neon orange color. These stripes help you to quickly identify twists in your leash. With a strength of 26 kN and a cover made of polyester this leash is made to endure many harsh highline sessions.
If you order this leash as an unsewn item we will send you a classic 350cm leash length. If you combine it with the HALO Leash Ring in our PRO Leash Set with a sewn loop we will use a 250 cm length - this shorter length provides the same usable length for your leash, because you don't need the knot in the leash ring anymore. So this can save you space and weight in your backpack.
The PRO Leash is certified for the use in highlines after ISA:37 by the International Slackline Association. This is the highest international safety standard and quality control available for highline gear.
notes: ISA:37 (approved_gear_10, 'PRO leash', product type Leash) — the certificate links the set; raed says the leash alone is certified, so both are matched. Live 2026-10-16. Braided polyester cover with neon orange stripes; core not stated. Sent unsewn at 350 cm. Manual: https://raed-slacklines.com/media/attachment/file/r/a/raed-leash-manual_1.pdf (held on the HALO ring).

name: PRO Highline Sewn Leash Set
description:
The raed PRO Highline Leash Set is a durable, strong and reliable partner for your highline rig despite its minimum weight. It combines the HALO Titanium Leash Ring and the PRO Leash with an ISA:37 certified sewn connection.
The HALO Leash Ring
It's completely made of Titanium, the metal with the best mechanic properties for engineering ultralight high strength gear. Compared to Aluminium and Steel it has by far the best strength to weight ratio - this allows us to design the HALO leash ring with the least amount of material at a maximum of strength. Titanium has no significant fatigue effects, so it won't crack under cyclic loading. This property, combined with a breaking strength of 88 kN provides full confidence to only use one leash ring in your highline leash.
The huge inner diameter of 72 mm lets the HALO Leashring easily pass across split connections and backup loops. The optimized inner geometry provides a big contact surface between ring and webbing - a feature that minimizes the wear of your webbing in leashfalls.
The PRO Highline Leash
The leash has a thickness of 12.7mm and a braided cover. This unique combination makes it easier for you to grip and climb the leash. The cover also comes with easily detectable stripe design that's even visible at bad light conditions due to its neon orange color. These stripes help you to quickly identify twists in your leash. With a strength of 26 kN and a cover made of polyester this leash is made to endure many harsh highline sessions.
If you order this leash as an unsewn item we will send you a classic 350cm leash length. If you combine it with the HALO Leash Ring in our PRO Leash Set with a sewn loop we will use a 250 cm length - this shorter length provides the same usable length for your leash, because you don't need the knot in the leash ring anymore. So this can save you space and weight in your backpack.
The PRO Leash Set is certified for the use in highlines after ISA:37 by the International Slackline Association. This is the highest international safety standard and quality control available for highline gear.
notes: ISA:37 certified (approved_gear_10, BLOCK Materialprüfungsgesellschaft, 2021-04). HALO Titanium ring sewn to the PRO leash; 250 cm sewn = a knotted 350 cm. EUR 109.95 Titanium, 119.95 in six anodised colours (Lizard Green, Magic Turquoise, Cherenkov Blue, Sparkling Pink, Mystic Purple, Rainbow). 26 kN is the leash's; the HALO is 88 kN. 2021: EUR 99.95. March 2024: nine 'B-color' variant pages. raed also sells a Leash Resewing Service (EUR 33.95). 2019: 'Leash Komplettset', EUR 39, 2 aluminium rings + threaded static rope (not catalogued: its page gives nothing else). Manual: https://raed-slacklines.com/media/attachment/file/r/a/raed-leash-manual_1.pdf (held on the HALO ring).

name: ALPINE Highline Leash Set
description:
The raed ALPINE leash is the lightest fully functional highline leash ever created. Period. Combining the HALO Titanium Leash Ring with a 10mm leash via a sewn connection brings it to a total weight of only 193 grams while providing an ISA:37 certified breaking strength of 17 kN.
The HALO Leash Ring
It's completely made of Titanium, the metal with the best mechanic properties for engineering ultralight high strength gear. The ALPINE Highline Leash
The ultralight leash has a thickness of 10.0mm, so it's not only lightweight, it also packs extremely small. With an ISA:37 certified strength of 17 kN and high stretch characteristics this leash is the ideal companion for extreme alpine highline adventures where every single gram in the backpack counts.
If you order this leash as an unsewn item we will send you a classic 350cm leash length. If you combine it with the HALO Leash Ring with a sewn loop we will use a 250 cm length - this shorter length provides the same usable length for your leash, because you don't need the knot in the leash ring anymore. The ALPINE Leash Set is certified for the use in highlines after ISA:37 by the International Slackline Association. This is the highest international safety standard and quality control available for highline gear.
notes: ISA:37 certified (approved_gear_11, BLOCK, 2021-04). HALO Titanium ring sewn to a 10.0 mm 'high stretch' leash, construction not stated; 193 g with the ring. 250 cm sewn (350 cm unsewn; the ALPINE leash is no longer sold alone). EUR 109.95 Titanium, 119.95 coloured. First listed 2021. Manual: https://raed-slacklines.com/media/attachment/file/r/a/raed-leash-manual_1.pdf (held on the HALO ring).

name: Highline Leash 335 cm
description:
This leash is made with a QUASAR 9.9 mm dynamic rope, threaded into a tight sleeve of 20 m LEASH LINE tubular polyamide webbing.
The LEASH has two seams at both ends, in order to fix the sleeve around the core rope. Thanks to these sewings, the two leash extremities work better to knot your fig-8 knots, while the central core maintains the necessary dynamism to preserve all the dynamic properties of the rope, making the fall much more comfortable for your body.
notes: Made in Italy. EU shop (captured 2026-10-11) splits it into BLUE (EUR 22.46), PINK and BLACK (EUR 24.13) pages; slacklines.us sells one product, US$34.95 (335 cm) / 38.45 (360 cm), refs HLSC/HLSK/HLSB + 3 or 6. 20 kN 'with fig-8 knot'. Rings: none, 1x or 2x 60 mm aluminium, 1x 80 mm HighRing, 1x 65 mm Vortex 2 (blue or purple); Donut ring protection option; 20 cm protection sleeve included. Lifespan per CAMP, typically 10 years. The text also calls 330 cm the standard length. The page declares the leash not PPE and, like all makers, 'not suitable for Highlining' (no field for this on leashes). History (product 215 on Spider and Slack Inov): 2020 EUR 20.95, CLASSIC or DYNAMIC (crinkled sleeve) model, 360 cm standard / 335 cm trick-highline, optional 30 cm TENDER sleeve; 2021 EUR 16.35 (Slack Inov); 2022 EUR 20.45; model choice gone by January 2023. Slack.fr resold it in 2022 (EUR 29.13, 335 cm, blue only).

name: Spliced Highline Leash
description:
The SPLICED Highline leash features a rope spliced around the HIGHRING, padded by DONUT, offering a design that is lighter than traditional double fig-8 knot leashes and preventing the tail whip commonly associated with knots.
This compact design uses a 14 mm diameter rope that is extremely flexible, easy to tie and untie, enhancing comfort during your highlining sessions.
With a strength of 54 kN on the spliced side and 25 kN on the fig-8 knot side, this leash will never fail.
notes: Ref HLSS4, 'TEMPORARILY UNAVAILABLE' on 2026-10-11. Made in France. Filed under Slack Inov, which the ISA's notice of 2026-09-01 names as its maker; Spider sells it (operator, 2026-10-17). Spliced around an 80 mm HighRing padded by a Donut; 463 g with both. MBS 25 kN on the fig-8 side (stored), 54 kN on the spliced side. 240 cm = a 335 cm leash with a fig-8. Lifespan 10 years. The rope's own build: 12-strand core, 24-strand sleeve ('12 fuses core, 24 fuses sleeve'); dynamic or static not stated.

name: Highline Leash Kit, no rings
description:
The SlackTech Highline Leash Kit has the all the components necessary to keep you safely connected to your highline. The leash is comprised of 12 ft of 9.9 mm Dynamic rope threaded inside a finely woven 11/16" tubular nylon. The leash is tied with a figure 8 knot to two 2 5/16" drop forged steel rings. The SlackTech Highline Leash Kit is designed to meet the rigors of repeated highining.
Dynamic rope threaded inside tubular webbing creates leash that is highly abrasion resistant and slightly stiffer than dynamic rope alone. This makes for more stable leash ring movement while walking because the rings are less prone to whipping around. The leash girth also provides a more friendly experience while leash climbing after that big whip; it's soft on both your hands and your feet!
The two 2 5/16" drop forged steel rings provide huge security when out in the middle of your highline. There are no seams, burs or welds in these rings, just pure strength! Each ring has been proof loaded to 3,600 lbf and are paired together to distribute the load of a leash fall over a larger surface of the highline.
notes: SlackTech closed. The kit's 'Leash Only' option: US$45.95 less $15.50 in 2014 (stored). 12 ft. Made in USA.

We looked at the knots, rings, handling characteristics, strength of historic leashes and Iktomi was presented. The trickster, the teacher, the shape shifter... Feel how your experience changes when walking with Iktomi.
notes: The 'Tie In System': the leash ring (leash ring 37) and an 8 ft leash spliced to it, tied in to the harness with a knot, so the knotted rope's 19.5 kN is stored. US$154.95 (2019). 'Slackline Ring Strength: 39 kN', 'Spliced Rope Strength: 39 kN', 'Knotted Rope Strength: 19.5 kN', 'Harness Ring Connection (x2): 44 kN', total weight < 1 lb, colour 'Hot'. Sold out in 2019.
